fusions.name: Barbed Haul
fusions.desc: Throws a barbed hook that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Grapple Lines
fusions.desc: Looses 2 hooked lines, each dealing 8 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on a target hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Snagline
fusions.desc: Drags every enemy near a baited line ahead of you inward for 6 seconds. Anything struck moves 25% slower for 2 seconds. The wall is 6 tiles long.

fusions.name: Catch and Hold
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
